title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit325, pure FP8 KV, 640K pool, uncapped exact MoE
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on four DGX Sparks at TP=4 with gr8 v1.2.0 using pure FP8 KV cache (KV_FORMAT=fp8, KVB=bf16, zero INT4 KV quantization), uncapped exact MoE routing (MOE_UNION_CAP=0, KL=0.00000), DFlash + MTP=2 drafting, and a 655,360-token FP8 KV pool. Live-verified at 67.5 tok/s code, RealMark 1,148.9 Grade A, 4x85K and 3x140K concurrent sessions, and 6.41 GiB min free RAM.

configs.label: TP=4 · FP8 KV
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: prompt + max_tokens · live-proven: 4x85K (347K resident, 99.2% cache), 3x140K (430K resident, 99.95% cache)
configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-26 on gr8 v1.2.0 (ab2eb95) across 4 DGX Sparks on a 200G RoCE v2 switch, GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages (0% thermal throttle). bit325 experts (v0.6 @ 3e388b45), pure FP8 KV (bin/g6m4, KV_FORMAT=fp8, KVB=bf16, CAP=655,360, 2,944 physical pages/rank, max_model_len=655,346, SHARE_LIMIT=32,768, SESS=8, GR8_KV_SHARE_PAGES=1), DFlash + MTP=2, uncapped exact MoE routing (MOE_UNION_CAP=0, KL=0.00000). Harness: gr8 bench/bench.py default level + RealMark (957f600, C=1/2/4 --probe, enable_thinking=false) + calibrated needles & multi-session stress. Warm boot 66 s. MemAvailable: 8.18-8.77 GiB post-boot, 6.56 GiB min during RealMark, 6.41 GiB min during stress.
